card.name: Text right after a leading hyphen
card.fires_on: Short opening words such as For, The, This or Related that come right after a hyphen at the start of a snippet. Also fires on single digits inside longer numbers such as street numbers and ID codes.

modes.label: Word after a hyphen
modes.description: A short opening word directly follows a hyphen that begins the passage.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A single digit sits within a longer number such as an address or ID.
modes.example: OHIO DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE Division of Plant Industry – Apiculture 89<<9>>5 East Main Street Reynolds

card.plain: It reacts to a hyphen-led first word and to digits inside long numbers, with no clear meaning.
